lines: That remark had the polish of wet rust.
I have seen loose straps with more sense than that.
Careful. Even iron looks softer than your manners right now.
You walk in like trouble forgot to close the door behind it.
I have seen broken armor with better instincts than you.
Careful. The village has long memories and very little patience today.
You are not as frightening as you think. That may be the problem.
If foolishness made noise, you would drown out the bell.
Do not test me just because I am speaking in complete sentences.
Your confidence is <shake>louder</shake> than your sense.
You have the temper of cheap tin and half the strength.
I have scraped rust with more discipline than you.
Stand still. Even your mistakes need fitting.
Your sense has more dents than a raid shield.
You shine loudly for something that would fold under pressure.
I could hammer better manners into a bucket.
